Infraestrutura - Docker / ESX / Elastic / Grafana / Nginx / VMware / Zabbix

🚨 CVE-2026-81938 - Grafana
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Grafana
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 7.7
Resumo:
Grafana Mimir's Alertmanager rejects tenant-supplied receiver configurations that reference local files, but the check did not cover two HTTP client settings: http_headers. A tenant permitted to upload an Alertmanager configuration could point these fields at any file readable by the Alertmanager process. When a notification was sent, Alertmanager read the file and put its contents in a header of the outgoing request...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-81938
 
🚨 CVE-2026-120460 - Docker
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Docker
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.8
Resumo:
Jpom through 2.11.12 contains a cross-workspace authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to manage other workspaces' Docker hosts by supplying foreign Docker asset ids. Attackers with Docker permission in any workspace can control containers, images, volumes and networks, including creating privileged containers with host bind mounts.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-120460
 
🚨 CVE-2026-120428 - Nginx
 
Criticidade: Média
Ferramenta: Nginx
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 6.1
Resumo:
PandaWiki 3.65.0 through 3.87.5 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to upload HTML files with image extensions via /share/v1/common/file/upload. Attackers can lure administrators to /static-file/ ?a=.pdf, bypassing the nginx attachment header to serve HTML inline and steal the panda_wiki_token JWT for session takeover.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-120428

📰 Optimizing Columnar Storage in Tanzu Greenplum, Part 1: Accelerating Filters with Implied Indexing
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: ESX
Fonte: https://blogs.vmware.com/feed
CVSS: 7.6
Resumo:
Tanzu Greenplum’s AO Columnar Store is already designed for efficient, high-speed analytics by eliminating the need for storage-intensive indexes and their ongoing maintenance. In part one of a two-part series, this post explores Implied Index (also known as the Ghost Index) in Tanzu Greenplum 7.6, a feature that accelerates selective WHERE-clause queries on AOCO tables …
Link: https://blogs.vmware.com/tanzu/optimizing-columnar-storage-in-tanzu-greenplum-part-1-accelerating-filters-with-implied-indexing/
 
📰 Optimizing Columnar Storage in Tanzu Greenplum, Part 2: Accelerating Hash Joins with Early Join Filtering
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: ESX
Fonte: https://blogs.vmware.com/feed
CVSS: 7.9
Resumo:
This post walks through Early Join Filtering (EJF) in Tanzu Greenplum 7.9. This extends the “read less, decide early” architecture to hash joins as EJF filters out non-matching rows before payload columns are ever materialized, delivering the query speed of an indexed table without the maintenance overhead.
Link: https://blogs.vmware.com/tanzu/optimizing-columnar-storage-in-tanzu-greenplum-part-2-accelerating-hash-joins-with-early-join-filtering/

Salt helps carry it through discovery, approved repair, and verification—at scale, across your entire fleet. Security wants to know which systems could be affected. Operations need the right packages, the right configuration, and a safe way to replace running workers.
Link: https://blogs.vmware.com/cloud-foundation/2026/11/03/php2shell-alert-to-action-using-vmware-salt/

That method has a single enforcement point in the framework, org.apach...

🚨 CVE-2026-105769 - Azure
 
Criticidade: Crítica
Ferramenta: Azure
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 9.3
Resumo:
kaniko before 1.25.20 can send a Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) access token for Azure Resource Manager to an attacker-controlled registry host. kaniko uses the Azure Container Registry credential helper github.com/chrismellard/docker-credential-acr-env, which decides whether a host is an ACR registry with an unanchored regular expression, so any hostname containing .azurecr.io, .azurecr.cn, .azurecr.de or .azurecr.us...
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-105769
